text:
alex: FYI - getting reports from 3 Dedicated customers in west-1: API calls are returning auth timeouts and 5xx, plus some odd billing spikes. Opening here so infra/support can triage.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-314. Pager duty notified.

maria: looking. Any repro steps or logs?

simon: customers say behavior started ~14:02 PDT — calls hang for ~10-30s then fail with `504` or `auth_timeout`. They also see `rate_limit` errors intermittently.

alex: pasting a truncated proxy log from one affected node:

```
2026-03-17T21:02:17Z proxy [req=0x7f8] INFO request start user=acct_98 model=gptx-dedicated
2026-03-17T21:02:27Z proxy [req=0x7f8] WARN downstream error code=504 message="placement_failed: no compatible instance"
2026-03-17T21:02:27Z auth [token_check] ERROR token validation timeout err="deadline exceeded"
2026-03-17T21:02:27Z proxy [req=0x7f8] ERROR fallback=throttle retries=3
```

ops_elaine: I can see autoscaler attempted to provision GPUs but cloud returned quota error for the tenant pool. Provider message: `QuotaExceeded: region-west-1 gpus (requested=16 available=0)`. Autoscaler retries were suppressed by a backoff bug.

simon: customers also reported rising queue lengths and an apparent noisy neighbor in one Dedicated pool that was pegging NVLink. Could be scheduling fragmentation.

support_kevin: one customer shared their request trace: repeated retries caused token usage to spike --> billing unexpected. Need to catch this for CS and billing.

maria: quick check: we tried region-failover to east-2 but requests were rejected by routing because of `model_variant: strict_compat` config. The failover logic refuses when model variants differ. That blocked graceful failover.

support_kevin: can we temporarily relax variant check while we bring up capacity? Something like:

```
# temporary routing patch
routing_policies["dedicated_failover"].compatibility = "allow_compatible_variants"
```

ops_elaine: I can patch that, but we need to ensure we don't break quantization expectations. Recommend enabling for a narrow set of tenants only.

alex: action items: (1) maria to patch routing policy for affected tenant list, (2) ops_elaine to request emergency GPU pool from provider + work around autoscaler backoff, (3) simon/support to notify customers & billing to review spikes, (4) infra to add short-term rate-limit for retries.

maria: rolling the routing patch now for tenants: acct_98, acct_102, acct_117. Command: `redwoodctl routing apply --policy dedicated_failover --set compatibility=allow_compatible_variants --tenants acct_98,acct_102,acct_117`. Will monitor.

ops_elaine: requested emergency capacity, provider accepted 8 GPUs on warm-standby for 30m window but placement will be manual. Working with host team to attach. Also hotfixed autoscaler backoff (PR #4891) and restarting scaler.

simon: customer-facing note drafted: "We experienced degraded Dedicated capacity in west-1 due to provider GPU shortage; we applied temporary routing and capacity fixes — your traffic should be routed with reduced latency in the next ~10-15m. We're reviewing billing impact." Posting to affected customers now.

oncall-bot: Deploy started: patch-routing v2026.03.17-allow-variants (CI job 9876).

maria: patch deployed. Verified failover now accepts east-2 for those tenants. I see success traces: `placement -> east-2 (ok)` and auth checks succeeding.

ops_elaine: emergency GPUs attached, autoscaler restarted, queue length dropping to baseline. Metrics: p95 latency for dedicated requests in west-1 dropped from 3.8s to 0.6s over 12 minutes.

support_kevin: customers notified and billing flagged for manual review (ticket BILL-674). Will revert routing relax after capacity stabilizes.

alex: leaving open until we confirm no new placement failures for 2 hours. Added follow-up: postmortem + prioritize autoscaler backoff fix in next patch. Good triage everyone. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-314 status -> Mitigated. Updates: 5 updates, 3 alerts suppressed.

maria: follow-up note: we should add a tolerance path in routing for quantization-compatible variants and surface this in the console as an opt-in failover setting. Filing RFC now.

alex: thanks — closing thread for now, will update when postmortem is ready.
